query: Florida 2026 gubernatorial GOP primary debate schedule Byron Donalds James Fishback David Jolly - any debates scheduled or held summer 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings on the Florida 2026 GOP gubernatorial primary debate situation:

**One primary debate held (July 2, 2026):** An unsanctioned, online-only "undercard" debate hosted by podcaster Patrick Bet-David on YouTube featured Paul Renner, Jay Collins, and James Fishback. Frontrunner **Byron Donalds skipped it** — he was named ~60 times in his absence.

**Donalds refuses to debate:** He has consistently declined, saying he'll only consider it once a rival hits **double-digit (10%) polling**. With polling averages showing Donalds ~51%, Fishback ~9%, Collins ~7%, Renner ~3%, no rival has met that threshold.

**No sanctioned GOP primary debate is scheduled** before the **August 18, 2026** primary.

**Only officially announced televised debate is a general-election one:** Oct 15, 2026 at Florida Atlantic University (part of the Decision 2026: Before YOU Vote series) — but it's for post-primary nominees, and it's disputed as "premature"/uncoordinated by Democratic frontrunner David Jolly and unsanctioned per the Republican Party of Florida.

**Note:** David Jolly is a **Democrat**, not part of the GOP primary — his debate role pertains to the general election.

Full report with sourcing and structured data points has been delivered.

key_facts: A Florida GOP gubernatorial debate was HELD on July 2, 2026 — an online-only, unsanctioned event hosted/moderated by podcaster Patrick Bet-David (PBD Podcast / 'The Future of Florida' YouTube livestream), lasting ~2 hours.
Participants in the July 2 debate: former FL House Speaker Paul Renner, Lt. Gov. Jay Collins, and businessman James Fishback. Frontrunner Byron Donalds did NOT attend.

Byron Donalds has consistently refused to debate rivals, stating he will only consider it once another candidate reaches double-digit (10%) polling; he called Fishback's confrontation 'another stunt.'
The Florida GOP primary is August 18, 2026; 12 Republicans are on the ballot with Donalds, Collins, Fishback, and Renner as the leading candidates.
No official party-sanctioned GOP PRIMARY debate is scheduled before Aug 18, 2026.

The only officially announced televised gubernatorial debate is a GENERAL-ELECTION debate on Oct 15, 2026 at Florida Atlantic University (Decision 2026: Before YOU Vote series), 7-8 p.m. EST; nominees invited only after the primary.

The Oct 15 FAU debate announcement was called 'premature' and uncoordinated by Democratic frontrunner David Jolly, and the Republican Party of Florida (Chair Evan Power) says it has not sanctioned any debates.
David Jolly is the Democratic frontrunner and is NOT in the GOP primary; his debate involvement pertains to the general election.
Polling average (270toWin, ~late June/early July 2026): Donalds ~51%, Fishback ~9%, Collins ~7%, Renner ~3%. Donalds claims ~55%.
Donalds had raised ~$90M-$100M and is backed by Trump and major FL Republicans (Moody, Uthmeier, Ingoglia, Simpson).
